notes: 0.3.0：新增官方脚本下载器（脚本 > 获取脚本…），可浏览、搜索并下载或升级官方脚本，安装走临时文件与原子替换，失败自动还原，运行中的脚本先停止再替换；菜单按对象重新分组，文件 > 打开收纳日志与配置位置，脚本菜单三组两分隔线，视图不再重复「隐藏到托盘」；Gitee/GitHub 下拉改为自绘扁平样式。
notes_en: 0.3.0: adds the official script downloader (Scripts > Get Scripts...) to browse, search, download and upgrade official scripts - installs go through a temp file and an atomic replace with rollback on failure, and running scripts are stopped first; menus are regrouped by object, File > Open collects the log and config locations, the Scripts menu has three bands with two dividers, and View no longer duplicates Hide to Tray; the Gitee/GitHub dropdown is now a flat custom-drawn control.
